# PG-GEN-REWRITING-COMMUTATION

Every injective rewriting of three labels is enumerated. Relation image, legality and merge action are recomputed on both sides of the rewriting square; a source xrx control stays xrx under injection. Lean proves the actual merge formula commutes with every injective Nat map. This does not yet establish the complete source ReachNoRemove induction.

Supported: Full six-permutation merge squares and legality invariance are exact; general injective merge rewriting and map composition are kernel checked.

Remaining: Prove source Step/ReachNoRemove and cost-potential transports for all term writings and the multi-step obstruction persistence theorem. Do not promote a finite permutation test into that source-wide result.
